narrative: Yen-led dollar selling and persistent intervention fears drive G10 FX dynamics as USD/JPY drops to 156.19 following hawkish comments from the BoJ governor. Cross-asset flows show gold higher +1.47% at $4,480, equities +0.46%, DXY -0.44%, and VIX 15.2. Fed-BoJ carry favors USD by 275bp, but USD/JPY 25d risk reversals at -1.82 signal heavy options demand for JPY downside protection. Focus shifts to the ECB policy decision on September 10.
